constraint_derivation.speed_setting: At clock entry the hand is within the stopped interval around 12; every supplied reconstruction TAS also enters with gTTCSpeedSetting=3.
constraint_derivation.spinner_identity: The published -4207.0 pre-event Y is exactly -4233 + 26, the top plane of the spinner centered at (1102,-4233,1682). The video shows Mario at this spinner.
constraint_derivation.location: The incident occurs at the spinner end beside the red coin centered at (800,-4400,1900). Exact X/Z are unavailable because no original controller movie or RAM capture exists.
constraint_derivation.action: The 29.97 fps VOD shows a landing followed by an airborne state before the transition. Stream frame loss prevents one exact game-frame action assignment.

platform_pointer_cases: every active object slot for stale-pointer testing

supplied_tas_corpus.assessment: The movies are short variants from one pre-TTC savestate. They stop around the entrance floor near (1400,-4822,-520), never approach the incident spinner, and do not constrain incident X/Z, velocity, action, input, or platform-pointer state.

evidence_limitations: No original savestate or RAM capture exists.
The legacy Google Drive package linked by the bounty is access-denied and could not be recovered from public archives.
The VOD is a lossy, composited 29.97 fps race stream and can omit N64 frames.
